Messages.Author: david.tatu
Messages.Body:
Master: unique location. Requires a ready cardinal. Hunting ground. During your untap phase, you may move 1 blood from the blood bank to each of the two oldest ready vampires you control. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground card each turn.

If I only have one vampire, can he gain a blood from Gurchon Hall?

If I have two vampires and another hunting ground, can vampire A get a blood from the hunting ground and vampire B get one from Gurchon hall?

Thanks,

David Tatu
V:EKN Scribe

Messages.Author: Kiddo
Messages.Body: I believe it is the case of you either give one blood to two different vampires or you get none at all. Terms for gaining blood are, I think, non-negotiable.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
If you don't have 2 vampires, you can't use Gurchon Hall.

You can't give blood from Gurchon Hall and another Hunting Ground to the same minion.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> david.tatu wrote:
> Master: unique location. Requires a ready cardinal. Hunting ground. During your untap phase, you may move 1 blood from the blood bank to each of the two oldest ready vampires you control. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground card each turn.
>
> If I only have one vampire, can he gain a blood from Gurchon Hall?
>
No. You need two ready vampires to gain blood from Gurchon Hall.

> david.tatu wrote:
> If I have two vampires and another hunting ground, can vampire A get a blood from the hunting ground and vampire B get one from Gurchon hall?
>
Only if "the hunting ground" A gains blood from is the Gurchon Hall. If it's the Jungle Hunting Ground (or any hunting ground other than Gurchon Hall), then, no.

Messages.Body:

Would that be sufficient to allow Gurchon Hall to work with only one ready vampire? If not, what would work?
